svg.text: Route: /admin/products (popup) · Screen: 1280 px wide desktop browser · Access: Admin only (admin site, signed in)
• The same form is used for Add and Edit, and opens from Barcode lookup (15b) with the scanned barcode filled in. A scan with a barcode reader while the form is open fills the Barcode
• On shorter screens the popup scrolls. The photo is uploaded after the product is saved; if only the photo fails, the form stays open and says so.

g.text: Scan with a barcode reader, or type manually
Optional. Without a photo, the kiosk shows the icon. JPEG, PNG
or WebP; it's made smaller before uploading.
For one serving. Use 0 for items served as they are, like bottled drinks.
Orders use it to estimate when they'll be ready.
